summary: No public GitHub repository was found for the DE2/LIM code from this paper. The paper states 'We built a prototype for LIM and DE2 in Python' but contains no code availability statement, no GitHub links, and no footnotes pointing to a repository. The first author's personal website (youl.org) lists the paper with only a PDF and slides — no code link — unlike several of their other papers which do provide downloadable code. The first author's GitHub account (you-li-nu) has 22 public repos, none of which contain DE2 or LIM implementations; the most recent repo was pushed in early 2023. Searches on GitHub (repo name, README text, code content) and web searches all returned no results for the authors' own code. It is likely that the code has not been publicly released as of the current date.
